summary: Hear the warden, wake the shrine, defeat the beast, and return with a verdict.

stages.title: Hear The Warden
stages.objectiveText: Speak with Warden Mirelle beside the lantern dais.
stages.objectiveHint: Press E near Mirelle after the intro camera pass ends.

stages.title: Wake The Shrine
stages.objectiveText: Inspect the Ember Shrine and defeat the Ashen Beast once it answers.
stages.objectiveHint: Press E near the shrine, then use Arcweaver's combat kit.

stages.title: Deliver Your Verdict
stages.objectiveText: Return to Warden Mirelle and choose how the valley should remember the trial.
stages.objectiveHint: Elder dialogue outcome applies a GAS blessing via trigger callback.
